# opencode-pillbox-statusline

A config-driven footer statusline for [OpenCode V2](https://opencode.ai/v2/docs/).
The footer is a row of pills: project, Git, agent and model, elapsed time,
subagents, context, cost, model tier, and provider quota. Every pill is a node
with its own settings, and all colors come from the active OpenCode theme.

Developed against OpenCode 2.0.29 and its plugin API.

## Table of Contents

- [Install](#install)
- [Configuration](#configuration)
- [Diagnostics](#diagnostics)
- [Data sources and privacy](#data-sources-and-privacy)
- [Development](#development)
- [Related projects](#related-projects)
- [License](#license)

## Install

Install [Pillbox from npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode-pillbox-statusline)
by adding the pinned package to your OpenCode configuration below. OpenCode
installs it automatically. For local development, use [a checkout](#from-a-checkout).

OpenCode passes `opencode.jsonc` options only to a plugin's server half, so
pillbox is registered twice: once in `opencode.jsonc` for the server half, which
fetches quota, and once in `cli.json` with the options for the terminal half.
Pin the same exact version in both.

```jsonc
// ~/.config/opencode/opencode.jsonc
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "plugins": [
    { "package": "opencode-pillbox-statusline@0.1.0", "options": { "tiers": false } }
  ]
}
```

The server half's only option is `tiers`; see
[Data sources and privacy](#data-sources-and-privacy) before turning it on.

```jsonc
// ~/.config/opencode/cli.json
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/v2/cli.json",
  "plugins": [
    "-opencode.prompt.footer",
    { "package": "opencode-pillbox-statusline@0.1.0", "options": {} }
  ]
}
```

Pillbox replaces the `prompt.footer.status` slot and adds to
`home.footer.status`. When two plugins replace the same slot, the one enabled
last wins, so disable any other footer plugin with a `-<plugin id>` entry in
the same `plugins` list. `-opencode.prompt.footer` also removes OpenCode's
command-palette hint.

### From a checkout

Use the absolute path of the checkout's `src` directory in place of the package
spec in both files, and run `npm install` in the checkout first. OpenCode looks
for the `index` and `tui` entry points in the directory you register, and the
terminal reloads plugins when their files change.

## Configuration

Options are keyed by pill id, so an override names only what changes. Lists
replace rather than merge. Built-in defaults apply first, then the preset, then
your options. A mistake drops only its own entry and shows up as an error; the
rest of the footer still renders.

```jsonc
{
  "package": "opencode-pillbox-statusline",
  "options": {
    "$schema": "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crag-h4k/opencode-pillbox-statusline/main/schema.json",
    "preset": "default",
    "pills": {
      "cost": { "enabled": false },
      "git": { "order": 15, "maxWidth": 24, "dirtyAccent": ["hue.yellow", "feedback.warning"] }
    }
  }
}
```

[`schema.json`](schema.json) describes the terminal options object for editors
and agents. See [Configuration](docs/config.md) for schema association, complete
defaults, validation behavior, and source settings, and [Pills](docs/pills.md)
for each pill's sizes, visibility rules, and specific options.

| Key | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `preset` | `default` or `minimal` (project, Git, context, and provider quota) |
| `icons` | `nerd`, `nerd-bmp` (no glyphs above U+FFFF), `unicode`, or `ascii` |
| `style` | `surface` (pill background), `caps` (`round`, `angled`, `square`, or `flat`; a style the icon set cannot draw falls back to `flat`), `gap` |
| `layout` | `reserve` (columns to leave empty after the session footer's pills; 0 by default, since the footer measures its own slot) and `hysteresis` |
| `sources` | `usage.refresh` and `tiers.refresh`: seconds between quota and model-category refreshes |
| `pills.<id>` | `enabled`, `when`, `group`, `order`, `priority`, `attach`, `size`, `minSize`, `minColumns`, `maxWidth`, `icon`, `accent`, `value`, plus the pill's own settings |

Pills: `hint`, `project`, `git`, `spinner`, `identity`, `elapsed`, `subagents`,
`sidequest` (off by default), `context`, `cost`, `tier`, and `provider`.

### Colors

Colors are tokens resolved against the active OpenCode theme, so pillbox has no
palette of its own. A setting can list several tokens; the first opaque color
wins.

| Token | Resolves to |
| --- | --- |
| `text.base`, `text.muted` | Theme text colors |
| `feedback.error`, `.warning`, `.success`, `.info` | Theme feedback colors |
| `hue.<name>` or `hue.<name>.<step>` | A hue scale; no step means 200 in dark mode and 300 in light |
| `categorical.<n>` | A categorical theme color |
| `agent` | The active agent's configured color |
| Any other dot path | For example `diff.background.context` |
| `#rrggbb` | A fixed color, for themes without a match |

Themes converted from the V1 format name their hues by angle, so `hue.yellow`
may be missing or another color. The defaults use only `text.*`, `feedback.*`,
`hue.accent`, `hue.interactive`, and `agent`, which every theme defines.

### Layout

Each pill starts at its preferred size. While the footer is too wide, the
lowest-priority pill that can still shrink steps down one size (full, compact,
icon, hidden). Ties go to the pill with the higher `order`. A pill with
`attach` hides together with that pill, and `minColumns` hides a pill below a
terminal width. A pill only grows back once `hysteresis` spare columns are free.

## Diagnostics

Run `/pillbox` or choose **Pillbox diagnostics** in the command palette. The
dialog has four sections: actual layout widths and hide reasons, sanitized
usage and tiers source states, resolved options and errors, and a glyph width
check. Use 1-4 to switch sections, arrows or Page Up/Down to scroll, and Escape
to close. No default keybinding is installed.

Layout uses the displayed footer's fit, including hysteresis, rather than a
second estimate. The glyph check shows code points and cell-width rulers for
the chosen icon set and custom overrides; compare the rulers in your terminal
to find missing or overlapping glyphs. See the
[diagnostics reference](docs/config.md#diagnostics) for state and hide-reason
definitions.

## Data sources and privacy

The server half reads your provider logins through OpenCode's integration API
and returns quota figures and source status to the terminal half: never tokens, account
ids, or raw responses. Every request has a 10-second timeout and refuses
redirects. Each provider is queried at most once a minute.

| Source | Host and endpoint | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GitHub Copilot quota | `api.github.com` (or your GitHub Enterprise API host) `/copilot_internal/user` | A `github-copilot` login exists |
| Codex quota | `chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/usage` | OpenAI is connected with ChatGPT OAuth and the token has not expired |
| Claude quota | `api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage` | Anthropic is connected with OAuth |
| Gateway quota | Local file `OPENCODE_PROVIDER_USAGE_FILE`, or `~/.cache/opencode/provider-usage/usage.json` | The file exists |
| Copilot model categories | Your account's `*.githubcopilot.com/models` (Enterprise: `copilot-api.<your host>`) | Only with `tiers: true` |

All of these endpoints are undocumented and can change without notice. The
pills show "unavailable" or disappear rather than display stale quota figures,
which are dropped after five minutes. Model categories keep their last good
map for the same account; diagnostics mark it stale after the six-hour cache
expires.

When the server option `tiers` is `true`, pillbox calls GitHub Copilot's
undocumented `/models` endpoint with your Copilot token and identifies as the
VS Code Copilot Chat integration (`Copilot-Integration-Id: vscode-chat`),
because that endpoint only answers editor clients. This may conflict with
GitHub's terms for Copilot. Leave it off unless you accept that. Without it, the
tier pill bands models by their catalog output price.

A gateway file is read only if it is a regular file of 64 KiB or less. It lists
`providers` keyed by provider id, each with `updatedAt` (epoch milliseconds) and
`windows` of `{ "period": "5h" | "week", "usedPercent": 0-100 }`. Entries for
`github-copilot`, `openai`, and `anthropic` are ignored because pillbox queries
those directly.

The quota RPC is local to your OpenCode server, but any client or plugin that
can call it learns which of these providers you are logged in to.

## Development

```sh
npm install
npm test
npm run typecheck
npm run build
```

The tests need Node 26.4 or newer: the render tests draw real frames with
OpenTUI, whose Node build uses `node:ffi`. The test script enables experimental
FFI explicitly and selects the test files by glob.

`npm run build` compiles `src/tui.tsx` and `src/diagnostics.tsx` into `dist/`
(ignored by Git). OpenCode compiles Solid JSX only for files outside
`node_modules`, so an installed package that ships the TSX paints its footer once
and never updates it: the spinner stays on one frame and late quota or cost
figures never appear. The package therefore exports the compiled `dist/tui.js`.
`npm pack` and `npm publish` build first.

Linting and the other checks run through [prek](https://prek.j178.dev/), locally on
every commit and in CI. The type check and the tests are hooks too, so run
`npm install` first.

```sh
uv tool install prek==0.5.4
prek install --overwrite
prek run --all-files
```

| Hook | Checks |
| --- | --- |
| gitleaks | Secrets in staged content |
| pre-commit-hooks | Whitespace, end of file, YAML and JSON syntax, merge markers, large files |
| actionlint | GitHub Actions workflows |
| markdownlint-cli2 | Markdown, configured in `.markdownlint.yaml` |
| biome-ci | TypeScript and JavaScript lint rules, configured in `biome.jsonc`; read-only, with the formatter off |
| typecheck, test | `tsc --noEmit` and the `node:test` suites |
| schema | `schema.json` matches the options schema; run `npm run schema` to regenerate it |

CI runs the same hooks from `.github/workflows/ci.yaml`, which calls the reusable
`.github/workflows/prek.yaml`. On `main`, the same workflow runs Release Please
and stages releases on npm; see [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md). Commit messages
follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/), because
Release Please builds the version and changelog from them.

The source lives in `src/`; everything at the top level is configuration, docs,
or tooling. A checkout loads from `src/`, which holds the `index`, `tui`, and
`rpc` entry points OpenCode looks for; the npm package maps `./tui` to the
compiled `dist/tui.js` and the other entry points to the same files in `src/`
through `package.json` exports.

```text
opencode-pillbox-statusline/
  src/
    index.ts            Server half: registers the pillbox.usage and pillbox.tiers RPCs
    tui.tsx             Terminal half: builds the data snapshot, measures, draws both footers
    diagnostics.tsx     Scrollable /pillbox dialog with layout, sources, options, and glyph sections
    diagnostics.mjs     Pure diagnostic reports and glyph samples; reads the displayed fit
    rpc.ts              RPC contracts shared by both halves
    quota.mjs           Quota parsing, normalization, and staleness shared by both halves
    config/             Options schema, defaults and presets, and the resolver
    pills/              One module per pill: defaults, own settings, and render
    render/             Bar model, priority fit, theme tokens, icons, widths, formatting
    server/             Quota and Copilot model-category sources
  test/                 node:test suites, OpenTUI render checks, real theme fixtures
  scripts/build.mjs     Compiles tui.tsx and diagnostics.tsx into dist/ for the npm package
  scripts/schema.mjs    Writes schema.json; --check fails when it is stale
  dist/                 Generated by npm run build; not committed, shipped in the package
  schema.json           JSON Schema for the terminal half's options
  docs/config.md        Options, schema setup, source states, and diagnostics reference
  docs/pills.md         Pill defaults, supported sizes, visibility, and specific settings
  RELEASING.md          How versions reach npm
```

## Related projects

- [opencode-sidequest](https://github.com/crag-h4k/opencode-sidequest) runs
  dependency graphs of sub-agent tasks with a live side panel. Pillbox's optional
  `sidequest` pill shows run progress; it is off by default.
- [dotfiles](https://github.com/crag-h4k/dotfiles) manages a selective macOS and
  Debian workstation with chezmoi, shared terminal palettes, and OpenCode tooling.

Pillbox works independently of both projects. You can use it with your own
OpenCode configuration.

# Configuration

Pillbox has separate terminal and server entries. Put presentation options in
the plugin's `options` object in `~/.config/opencode/cli.json` (or
`$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/opencode/cli.json`). Only the `tiers` switch belongs in
`opencode.json(c)`. See [installation](../README.md#install) for both entries.

## Editors and schema

[`schema.json`](../schema.json) describes the terminal **options object**, not
the whole CLI configuration. It ships in the npm package. The published source
URL is:

```text
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crag-h4k/opencode-pillbox-statusline/main/schema.json
```

Use `https://opencode.ai/v2/cli.json` as the root `$schema` of `cli.json` and
`https://opencode.ai/config.json` in `opencode.json(c)`. Pillbox accepts an
`options.$schema` hint, but some editors apply `$schema` only at the document
root. In those editors, validate a standalone copy of the options object
against Pillbox's schema, or configure a schema association for that object.
Use a release tag instead of `main` in the URL to match a pinned release.

```jsonc
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/v2/cli.json",
  "plugins": [
    "-opencode.prompt.footer",
    {
      "package": "opencode-pillbox-statusline@0.1.0",
      "options": {
        "$schema": "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crag-h4k/opencode-pillbox-statusline/main/schema.json",
        "icons": "nerd-bmp",
        "pills": {
          "cost": { "enabled": false },
          "git": { "maxWidth": 24 }
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

## Resolution and errors

Built-in defaults apply first, then the preset, then your overrides. Objects
merge recursively; arrays replace. An invalid top-level entry falls back as a
unit. An invalid pill entry falls back as a unit, without discarding other
pills. Unknown keys are errors, with spelling suggestions where possible.

An unsupported preferred size moves to the next supported smaller size. A
`minSize` larger than the preferred size is repaired, and attachment cycles are
broken. These repairs also produce errors. The terminal shows a warning toast
and logs option errors when the plugin loads. `/pillbox`, section **Options**,
shows all errors and the complete resolved terminal options.

## Root options

| Key | Default | Values and behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `preset` | `default` | `default`, `minimal` |
| `icons` | `nerd` | `nerd`, `nerd-bmp`, `unicode`, `ascii` |
| `style.surface` | `background.raised.base`, `hue.neutral.700`, `diff.background.context` | Ordered fallback list of theme colors |
| `style.caps` | `round` | `round`, `angled`, `square`, `flat`; `none` is an alias for `flat` |
| `style.gap` | `1` | Integer cells between pills, 0-4 |
| `layout.reserve` | `0` | Integer cells removed from the footer budget, 0-200 |
| `layout.hysteresis` | `2` | Spare cells needed before a session pill grows back, 0-20 |
| `sources.usage.refresh` | `60` | Seconds between quota RPC polls, 15-3600 |
| `sources.tiers.refresh` | `21600` | Seconds between category RPC polls, 600-86400 |

`minimal` disables identity, elapsed, subagents, cost, and tier. It retains the
project, Git, context, and provider pills, plus the interrupt hint. The spinner
is attached to identity, so it also disappears unless identity is re-enabled.
Sidequest stays disabled in either preset.

Nerd Font sets need a compatible font. `nerd-bmp` avoids code points above
U+FFFF for terminals that mishandle supplementary-plane glyphs. `unicode` uses
no private-use glyphs, and `ascii` uses printable ASCII only. Round and angled
caps fall back to flat in `unicode` and `ascii`; square caps also fall back to
flat in `ascii`. If the theme has no opaque surface color, the renderer drops
caps regardless of the configured style.

## Per-pill options

Each entry under `pills` accepts these keys. The [pill reference](pills.md)
lists supported sizes, individual defaults, and pill-specific settings.

| Key | Default | Values and behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` except sidequest | Boolean |
| `when` | `session` except project and Git (`always`) | `session`, `home`, `always` |
| `group` | `left` except provider (`right`) | Alignment group |
| `order` | Per pill | Integer 0-1000, increasing within the group |
| `priority` | Per pill | Integer 0-100; higher survives longer |
| `attach` | Unset except spinner and tier (`identity`) | Another pill id; hide when that pill is absent or hidden |
| `size` | `full` except spinner (`icon`) | Preferred supported size: `full`, `compact`, `icon` |
| `minSize` | `hidden` | Smallest allowed size, or `hidden` to allow removal |
| `minColumns` | `0` | Hide below this terminal width, integer 0-1000 |
| `maxWidth` | Per pill where used | Integer 1-200; limits text fields in project, Git, identity, and sidequest |
| `icon` | Icon set | Nonempty override string; may occupy multiple cells |
| `accent` | Per pill | Icon color token or fallback list |
| `value` | `text.base` except hint | Text color token or fallback list |

`maxWidth` is not a cap on the complete pill: Git's counts and identity's agent
and effort fields have their own widths. Numerical pills do not use it.
Dynamic states can override `accent`, including dirty Git, provider quota
thresholds, and tier bands. Configure their specific color settings instead.

## Fit and colors

The session footer measures its slot, subtracts `layout.reserve`, and fits
pills into that budget. The home footer uses the terminal width minus reserve.
`minColumns` always refers to terminal width, even if a sidebar or neighboring
footer element leaves a smaller slot.

The fit starts at each pill's preferred size. The lowest-priority pill steps
down through its supported sizes, then hides if allowed. Equal priorities
shrink the pill with the higher `order` first. An attachment hides when its
parent disappears. Session pills grow only when the result leaves the
configured hysteresis slack; shrinking is immediate. If minimum sizes prevent
a fit, diagnostics report overflow.

Colors resolve against the active theme. A fallback list uses the first opaque
color. Tokens include `text.base`, `text.muted`, `feedback.error`,
`feedback.warning`, `feedback.success`, `feedback.info`, `hue.<name>`,
`hue.<name>.<step>`, `categorical.<n>`, and `agent`. A hue without a step uses
200 in dark mode or 300 in light mode. Other dotted theme paths and `#rrggbb`
are accepted. See the [README color table](../README.md#colors).

## Sources

Polling runs only while the corresponding pill is enabled: provider for
usage, tier for categories. A poll has a 15-second timeout and cannot overlap
another poll of the same source. Server requests have their own 10-second
timeouts. Each quota provider and the gateway file are cached for one minute,
so a shorter terminal interval does not force more upstream requests.

Quota figures older than five minutes are removed before rendering. Copilot
categories cache for six hours and back off for fifteen minutes on failure;
the last good category map is kept for the same account. Unlike quota figures,
stale categories remain usable. A category request is allowed only when the
server's plugin entry has `"options": { "tiers": true }`. Read the
[privacy and endpoint notes](../README.md#data-sources-and-privacy) before
enabling it.

## Diagnostics

Run `/pillbox` or select **Pillbox diagnostics** in the command palette. No
default shortcut is bound. Use 1-4 to choose a section, arrows or Page Up/Down
to scroll, and Escape to close.

| Section | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| Layout | Current footer's terminal width, budget, actual fitted width, overflow, effective caps, every pill's selected size and width or hide reason, and measured candidate sizes |
| Sources | RPC polling state and last success, direct and gateway quota freshness and auth kind, category source state and category counts |
| Options | All load-time option errors, followed by the resolved terminal options |
| Glyphs | Chosen icon set, every spinner frame and tier glyph, cap glyphs, custom icon overrides, code points, computed cell widths, and visual rulers |

Layout reads the mounted footer's existing fit, including hysteresis. It does
not recompute a second layout. Layout and source state update while the dialog
is open. A page with no mounted Pillbox footer says so.

Hide reasons distinguish `disabled`, the wrong footer (`when`), absent data or
inactive state (`no-data`), no content at a supported size (`empty`),
`minColumns`, a hidden attachment (`attached`), and insufficient `space`.
Space includes a pill held hidden by hysteresis.

RPC `disabled` means the terminal is not polling because its pill is disabled.
RPC `ready` means a call succeeded, not that every provider returned quota.
`error` covers a missing server plugin, timeout, or failed call. A provider
marked `not reported` may be disconnected or unavailable; it is not proof of
a missing login. Gateway entries appear only while the server considers them
valid, so absent files and invalid files cannot be distinguished here.

The category source separately reports `disabled`, `unavailable`, `ready`, or
`stale`. Older server halves that do not report this field show `unknown`.
Source diagnostics select quota numbers, auth kind, timestamps, and category
counts. They do not display tokens, account ids, raw responses, raw exceptions,
model inventories, or the gateway file path. Options show your configured
values, including custom icon strings.

For glyph checks, compare each sample's closing bar to the ruler below it.
Computed cell widths cannot verify font coverage or how your terminal paints
a glyph. If the bars do not line up or icons overlap, try `nerd-bmp`, `unicode`,
or `ascii`. Configured caps are shown here even when the active theme causes
the footer to use flat caps; **Layout** reports the effective style.

# Pill reference

Pills are configured by id under the terminal entry's `options.pills`. Shared
keys and layout behavior are documented in [Configuration](config.md). Use
`/pillbox` to see which size the actual fit selected and why a pill is hidden.

## Defaults

All pills default to `size: "full"` and `minSize: "hidden"` except spinner,
whose only size is `icon`. They appear in the session footer unless noted.
All are enabled except sidequest. Every pill uses `text.base` for values except
hint, which uses `text.muted`.

| Id | Sizes | Order | Priority | Default accent | Placement and attachment |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hint` | full | 0 | 100 | `text.muted` | Left, plain text |
| `project` | full, icon | 10 | 95 | `feedback.info` | Left, home and session |
| `git` | full, compact, icon | 20 | 90 | `feedback.success` | Left, home and session |
| `spinner` | icon | 39 | 60 | `hue.accent` | Left, plain, attached to identity |
| `identity` | full, compact, icon | 40 | 60 | `hue.interactive` | Left |
| `elapsed` | full, icon | 50 | 30 | `hue.accent` | Left |
| `subagents` | full, icon | 60 | 75 | `feedback.warning` | Left |
| `sidequest` | full, compact | 65 | 55 | `feedback.info` | Left, disabled |
| `context` | full, compact | 70 | 65 | `hue.accent` | Left |
| `cost` | full, compact | 80 | 50 | `feedback.success` | Left |
| `tier` | full, icon | 90 | 40 | By band | Left, attached to identity |
| `provider` | full, compact | 100 | 85 | By quota | Right |

## Hint and spinner

`hint` shows the interrupt shortcut while the session runs, or `esc exit shell
mode` in shell mode. It is absent while idle. It has no surface or caps.

`spinner` animates one cell while foreground model or tool work runs. It stops
and hides while waiting for permission or form input, in shell mode, or while
idle. It also hides with identity. The frame set follows `icons`.

## Project

Shows the project name, falling back to its directory basename. `maxWidth`
defaults to 18 cells. The full size truncates the name with an ellipsis; icon
size keeps only the icon. No project name means no pill.

## Git

Shows the branch, dirty-file count, and in full size, additions and deletions.
Compact drops line counts; icon drops all text. A clean worktree shows only
the branch in full and compact sizes. No branch means no pill.

| Setting | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `maxWidth` | `18` | Branch-name width, before counts |
| `dirtyAccent` | `feedback.warning` | Icon color when files have changes |

## Identity

Shows the active agent and model id. Full adds the model variant when present;
compact omits it, and icon omits all text. No agent means no pill. The agent
name is limited to 12 cells, and the variant to 10.

| Setting | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `maxWidth` | `20` | Model-id width |
| `agentColor` | `agent` | Agent-name color from its configured color or categorical fallback |
| `effortColor` | `feedback.warning` | Variant text color |
| `showEffort` | `true` | Include the variant in full size |

## Elapsed

Wall-clock age since session creation, such as `<1m`, `12m`, or `1d2h`.
This is session age, not model execution time. The icon size drops the age.
No creation timestamp means no pill.

## Subagents

Shows running child sessions and queued child prompts across the session
family. It animates while children run, including when the foreground session
is idle. Queued-only work uses a static icon. It hides when both counts are
zero. Icon size drops the counts.

## Sidequest

The pure renderer supports a run name, done/total count, and failed count.
`maxWidth` defaults to 16 for the name; compact drops the name. Failed runs
use `feedback.error`.

The terminal adapter does not yet supply Sidequest run data. Enabling this
pill alone therefore leaves it hidden with `no-data`. It defaults off because
opencode-sidequest already supplies its own progress strip.

## Context

Uses the latest assistant message after the most recent completed compaction,
respecting the session's revert boundary. Full shows token count and, when a
model limit is known, its percentage. Compact shows the percentage, or the
token count when no limit is known. Zero or missing token usage hides it.

## Cost

Uses OpenCode's aggregate session-family cost in USD. Full shows cents;
compact rounds to whole dollars. Zero or missing cost hides it. Provider
subscription quota is separate and does not contribute a dollar estimate.

## Tier

Shows the active model's cost band. Copilot category data takes precedence for
GitHub Copilot models. Other models, and those without a recognized category,
use catalog output price in USD per million tokens. With neither category nor
price, the pill hides. Icon size omits the band label.

| Band | Catalog output price | Copilot category | Default band color |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| included | At most $5 | `lightweight` | `feedback.success` |
| standard | Above $5 through $12 | `versatile` | `feedback.info` |
| premium | Above $12 through $20 | `powerful` with known output price below $25 | `feedback.warning` |
| heavy | Above $20 | `powerful` with unknown output price or at least $25 | `feedback.error` |

`ramp` chooses `value` (default, circle/cash/gem/sack in the Nerd set) or `heat`
(snowflake/campfire/fire/fire-alert). `bands.included`, `bands.standard`,
`bands.premium`, and `bands.heavy` override colors independently. A custom
`icon` overrides the selected ramp glyph.

Category requests require the server's `tiers: true` switch. Without it,
catalog price fallback still works. See the
[source documentation](config.md#sources) and
[endpoint notes](../README.md#data-sources-and-privacy).

## Provider

Shows quota for the active model's provider. Full includes its name and quota;
compact keeps a shorter quota summary. It has no icon-only size.

| Provider | Display |
| --- | --- |
| GitHub Copilot | Monthly percentage used, or unlimited. Without figures, shows only the name in the error color |
| OpenAI via ChatGPT OAuth | Codex weekly percentage left. Missing weekly quota reads `Codex unavailable` (compact: `Codex`) |
| Anthropic via OAuth | Available 5-hour and weekly percentages used |
| Gateway file | Available 5-hour and weekly percentages used |
| OpenAI API key, or any other provider without quota windows | Hidden |

| Setting | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `accent` | `feedback.info` | Normal quota icon color |
| `warnAt` | `70` | Used percentage at or above which `warning` applies |
| `errorAt` | `90` | Used percentage at or above which `error` applies |
| `warning` | `feedback.warning` | Warning icon color |
| `error` | `feedback.error` | Error icon color |

Thresholds are integers from 0 to 100. Error is checked before warning. When
several windows exist, the highest used percentage controls color and compact
text. Codex text shows remaining percentage, but its color still uses the used
percentage. Figures expire after five minutes; the diagnostics source section
shows freshness independently of whether the current provider pill is visible.
